classes:
  Annotation:
    class_uri: ex:Annotation
    description: Free-form metadata about an asserted triple (e.g. meta:accordingTo, meta:confidence, meta:assertedAt). Permissive.
    extra_slots:
      allowed: true
      range_expression:
        any_of:
        - range: string
        - range: double
        - range: boolean
        - inlined: true
          range: InlineDefsAnnotationAdditionalPropertiesAnyOf3Object
        - inlined: true
          range: InlineDefsAnnotationAdditionalPropertiesAnyOf4Object
    title: RDF-1.2 statement metadata (reifier annotation)
  Holder:
    attributes:
      '@annotation':
        alias: '@annotation'
        inlined: true
        range: Annotation
        required: false
      '@id':
        alias: '@id'
        range: string
        required: false
      '@type':
        alias: '@type'
        any_of:
        - range: string
        - multivalued: true
          range: string
        required: false
      ex:and:
        alias: ex:and
        all_of:
        - any_of:
          - range: integer
          - inlined: true
            range: InlineDefsShapeRef0AnyOf1Object
        - range: ShapeRef1
        required: false
        slot_uri: ex:and
      ex:node:
        alias: ex:node
        any_of:
        - any_of:
          - range: integer
          - inlined: true
            range: InlineDefsShapeRef2AnyOf1Object
        - any_of:
          - range: integer
          - inlined: true
            range: InlineDefsShapeRef2AnyOf1Object
          multivalued: true
        required: false
        slot_uri: ex:node
      ex:not:
        alias: ex:not
        all_of:
        - none_of:
          - any_of:
            - range: integer
            - inlined: true
              range: InlineDefsShapeRef3AnyOf1Object
        required: false
        slot_uri: ex:not
      ex:or:
        alias: ex:or
        all_of:
        - any_of:
          - any_of:
            - range: integer
            - inlined: true
              range: InlineDefsShapeRef4AnyOf1Object
          - inlined: true
            range: ShapeRef5
        required: false
        slot_uri: ex:or
      ex:some:
        alias: ex:some
        any_of:
        - all_of:
          - any_of:
            - range: integer
            - inlined: true
              range: InlineDefsShapeRef6AnyOf1Object
          any_of:
          - range: boolean
          - range: double
          - inlined: true
            range: InlineDefsHolderPropertiesExSomeAnyOf0Type2Object
          - range: string
        - any_of:
          - range: boolean
          - range: double
          - inlined: true
            range: InlineDefsHolderPropertiesExSomeAnyOf1ItemsType2Object
          - range: string
          has_member:
            any_of:
            - range: integer
            - inlined: true
              range: InlineDefsShapeRef6AnyOf1Object
          minimum_cardinality: 1
          multivalued: true
        required: true
        slot_uri: ex:some
      ex:xone:
        alias: ex:xone
        all_of:
        - exactly_one_of:
          - any_of:
            - range: integer
            - inlined: true
              range: InlineDefsShapeRef7AnyOf1Object
          - range: ShapeRef8
        required: false
        slot_uri: ex:xone
    class_uri: ex:Holder
    extra_slots:
      allowed: true
  InlineDefsAnnotationAdditionalPropertiesAnyOf3Object:
    attributes:
      '@id':
        alias: '@id'
        range: string
        required: true
    class_uri: ex:InlineDefsAnnotationAdditionalPropertiesAnyOf3Object
    extra_slots:
      allowed: true
  InlineDefsAnnotationAdditionalPropertiesAnyOf4Object:
    attributes:
      '@type':
        alias: '@type'
        range: string
        required: false
      '@value':

        range: string
        required: true
    class_uri: ex:InlineDefsAnnotationAdditionalPropertiesAnyOf4Object
    extra_slots:
      allowed: true
  InlineDefsHolderPropertiesExSomeAnyOf0Type2Object:
    class_uri: ex:InlineDefsHolderPropertiesExSomeAnyOf0Type2Object
    extra_slots:
      allowed: true
  InlineDefsHolderPropertiesExSomeAnyOf1ItemsType2Object:
    class_uri: ex:InlineDefsHolderPropertiesExSomeAnyOf1ItemsType2Object
    extra_slots:
      allowed: true
  InlineDefsShapeRef0AnyOf1Object:

      '@type':

      '@value':
        alias: '@value'

        range: string
        required: true
    class_uri: ex:InlineDefsShapeRef0AnyOf1Object
    extra_slots:
      allowed: true
  InlineDefsShapeRef2AnyOf1Object:
    attributes:

        alias: '@value'
        pattern: ^[\t\n\r ]*(?:[+\-]?(?:0+|0*(?:[1-9][0-9]*)))[\t\n\r ]*$
        range: string
        required: true
    class_uri: ex:InlineDefsShapeRef2AnyOf1Object
    extra_slots:
      allowed: true
  InlineDefsShapeRef3AnyOf1Object:
    attributes:
      '@type':
        alias: '@type'
        equals_string: xsd:integer
        required: true
      '@value':
        alias: '@value'
        pattern: ^[\t\n\r ]*(?:[+\-]?(?:0+|0*(?:[1-9][0-9]*)))[\t\n\r ]*$
        range: string
        required: true
    class_uri: ex:InlineDefsShapeRef3AnyOf1Object
    extra_slots:
      allowed: true
  InlineDefsShapeRef4AnyOf1Object:
    attributes:
      '@type':
        alias: '@type'
        equals_string: xsd:integer
        required: true
      '@value':
        alias: '@value'
        pattern: ^[\t\n\r ]*(?:[+\-]?(?:0+|0*(?:[1-9][0-9]*)))[\t\n\r ]*$
        range: string
        required: true
    class_uri: ex:InlineDefsShapeRef4AnyOf1Object
    extra_slots:
      allowed: true
  InlineDefsShapeRef5AnyOf0Object:
    attributes:
      '@id':
        alias: '@id'
        pattern: ^(?:[^_]|_(?:[^:]|$))
        range: string
        required: true
    class_uri: ex:InlineDefsShapeRef5AnyOf0Object
    extra_slots:
      allowed: true
  InlineDefsShapeRef5AnyOf1Object:
    attributes:
      '@list':
        alias: '@list'
        list_elements_ordered: true
        maximum_cardinality: 0
        multivalued: true
        range: string
        required: true
    class_uri: ex:InlineDefsShapeRef5AnyOf1Object
    extra_slots:
      allowed: true
  InlineDefsShapeRef6AnyOf1Object:
    attributes:
      '@type':
        alias: '@type'
        equals_string: xsd:integer
        required: true
      '@value':
        alias: '@value'
        pattern: ^[\t\n\r ]*(?:[+\-]?(?:0+|0*(?:[1-9][0-9]*)))[\t\n\r ]*$
        range: string
        required: true
    class_uri: ex:InlineDefsShapeRef6AnyOf1Object
    extra_slots:
      allowed: true
  InlineDefsShapeRef7AnyOf1Object:
    attributes:
      '@type':
        alias: '@type'
        equals_string: xsd:integer
        required: true
      '@value':
        alias: '@value'
        pattern: ^[\t\n\r ]*(?:[+\-]?(?:0+|0*(?:[1-9][0-9]*)))[\t\n\r ]*$
        range: string
        required: true
    class_uri: ex:InlineDefsShapeRef7AnyOf1Object
    extra_slots:
      allowed: true
  Node:
    attributes:
      '@annotation':
        alias: '@annotation'
        inlined: true
        range: Annotation
        required: false
      '@id':
        alias: '@id'
        range: string
        required: false
      '@type':
        alias: '@type'
        any_of:
        - range: string
        - multivalued: true
          range: string
        required: false
    class_uri: ex:Node
    description: 'Validated by @type: a node typed ex:Foo MUST satisfy #/$defs/Foo (closed-world). Nodes typed only by unmodeled classes are permissively allowed.'
    extra_slots:
      allowed: true
    title: A single discriminated PURRDF instance node
  ShapeRef5:
    any_of:
    - is_a: InlineDefsShapeRef5AnyOf0Object
    - is_a: InlineDefsShapeRef5AnyOf1Object
    class_uri: ex:ShapeRef5
    extra_slots:
      allowed: true
